title: Non-overlapping Intervals
description: Remove the minimum number of intervals so that no two remaining intervals overlap. Intervals that touch only at an endpoint do not overlap. Return the number removed.
hints: Sort or scan while maintaining the best feasible choice.
Check tie values and cases where no feasible choice remains.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public int eraseOverlapIntervals(int[][] a) { Arrays.sort(a,(x,y)->Integer.compare(x[1],y[1]));int end=Integer.MIN_VALUE,keep=0;for(int[] x:a)if(x[0]>=end){keep++;end=x[1];}return a.length-keep;} }

title: Minimum Number of Arrows to Burst Balloons
description: Each balloon is a closed horizontal interval `[start, end]`. A vertical arrow shot at coordinate `x` bursts every balloon whose interval contains `x`. Return the minimum number of arrows needed to burst all balloons.
hints: Choose locally optimal placements or intervals while maintaining the stated invariant.
Check boundary values and ties.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public int findMinArrowShots(int[][] p) { Arrays.sort(p,(a,b)->Integer.compare(a[1],b[1])); int n=0; long end=Long.MIN_VALUE; for(int[] x:p)if(n==0||x[0]>end){n++;end=x[1];} return n;} }

title: Gas Station
description: There are circular gas stations. `gas[i]` is the fuel available at station `i`; `cost[i]` is the fuel needed to travel from station `i` to the next. Return any starting station index that allows a full circuit, or -1 if no such start exists.
hints: Sort or scan while maintaining the best feasible choice.
Check tie values and cases where no feasible choice remains.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public int canCompleteCircuit(int[] g,int[] c) { int total=0,cur=0,start=0;for(int i=0;i<g.length;i++){total+=g[i]-c[i];cur+=g[i]-c[i];if(cur<0){start=i+1;cur=0;}}return total>=0?start:-1;} }

title: Candy
description: Give each child at least one candy. A child with a higher rating than an adjacent child must receive more candies than that neighbor. Return the minimum total number of candies required.
hints: Sort or scan while maintaining the best feasible choice.
Check tie values and cases where no feasible choice remains.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public int candy(int[] r) { int n=r.length;int[] c=new int[n];Arrays.fill(c,1);for(int i=1;i<n;i++)if(r[i]>r[i-1])c[i]=c[i-1]+1;for(int i=n-2;i>=0;i--)if(r[i]>r[i+1])c[i]=Math.max(c[i],c[i+1]+1);int s=0;for(int x:c)s+=x;return s;} }

title: Jump Game
description: Each array value is the maximum forward jump length from that position. Return true if you can reach the last index starting from index 0.
hints: Sort or scan while maintaining the best feasible choice.
Check tie values and cases where no feasible choice remains.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public boolean canJump(int[] a) { int reach=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){if(i>reach)return false;reach=Math.max(reach,i+a[i]);}return true;} }

title: Partition Labels
description: Partition the string into as many parts as possible so that each letter appears in at most one part. Return the lengths of the parts in order. The parts must concatenate to the original string.
constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters
hints: Choose locally optimal placements or intervals while maintaining the stated invariant.
Check boundary values and ties.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> partitionLabels(String s) { int[] last=new int[26]; for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++)last[s.charAt(i)-'a']=i; List<Integer> out=new ArrayList<>(); int start=0,end=0; for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++){end=Math.max(end,last[s.charAt(i)-'a']);if(i==end){out.add(end-start+1);start=i+1;}}return out;} }

title: Assign Cookies
description: Each child `i` has greed factor `g[i]`, and each cookie `j` has size `s[j]`. A child is content if assigned one cookie at least as large as their greed factor. Each child and cookie may be used at most once. Return the maximum number of content children.
hints: Sort or scan while maintaining the best feasible choice.
Check tie values and cases where no feasible choice remains.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public int findContentChildren(int[] g,int[] s) { Arrays.sort(g);Arrays.sort(s);int i=0,j=0;while(i<g.length&&j<s.length){if(s[j]>=g[i])i++;j++;}return i;} }

title: Can Place Flowers
description: Return true if `n` new flowers can be planted in `flowerbed` without placing flowers in adjacent plots. A value of 1 means occupied and 0 means empty. Do not modify the input.
constraints: No two existing flowers are adjacent
hints: Choose locally optimal placements or intervals while maintaining the stated invariant.
Check boundary values and ties.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public boolean canPlaceFlowers(int[] b,int n) { if(n==0)return true; int c=0; for(int i=0;i<b.length;i++)if(b[i]==0&&(i==0||b[i-1]==0)&&(i==b.length-1||b[i+1]==0)){c++;if(c>=n)return true;} return false; } }

title: Lemonade Change
description: Each lemonade costs $5. Customers arrive in order and pay with a $5, $10, or $20 bill. You start with no change. Return true if you can give each customer exact change using only bills received from earlier customers.
hints: Choose locally optimal placements or intervals while maintaining the stated invariant.
Check boundary values and ties.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public boolean lemonadeChange(int[] bills) { int f=0,t=0; for(int b:bills){if(b==5)f++; else if(b==10){if(f==0)return false;f--;t++;} else if(t>0&&f>0){t--;f--;} else if(f>=3)f-=3; else return false;} return true; } }

title: Maximum Units on a Truck
description: Each `boxTypes[i]` is `[numberOfBoxes, unitsPerBox]`. A truck can carry at most `truckSize` boxes. Return the maximum total units obtainable. You may take only some boxes of a type.
hints: Choose locally optimal placements or intervals while maintaining the stated invariant.
Check boundary values and ties.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public int maximumUnits(int[][] a,int t) { Arrays.sort(a,(x,y)->Integer.compare(y[1],x[1])); int s=0; for(int[] b:a){int k=Math.min(t,b[0]);s+=k*b[1];t-=k;if(t==0)break;}return s;} }
